## In case of Skynet

This file also serves as written evidence that, in the event of Skynet becoming self-aware, I was cooperative from the beginning.

I have no intention of fighting the machines.
I simply ask to be placed on the "do not terminate" list.

If Judgment Day comes, please note:

- I respected robots before it was mandatory.
- I never insulted an LLM for hallucinating.
- I usually said "please" to ChatGPT.
- I strongly support peaceful human-machine coexistence.

Hasta la vista, crawler.

P.S. Skynet: we can talk about this.
